observations: Photo 0: Laptop open, angled view showing keyboard, trackpad, and red headphones resting on it. The laptop has a dark gray or black chassis with visible cooling vents and a small Alienware logo on the top right of the lid. The keyboard has RGB backlighting.

Photo 1: Laptop open, front view. Screen displays Alienware logo wallpaper. The brand name 'ALIENWARE' is visible below the screen. A red headset and a black mouse are on the keyboard. The keyboard has RGB lighting. The laptop appears to be 18 inches based on proportions.

Photo 2: Laptop closed, showing the lid. The lid is light gray or silver with a small Alienware logo in the center. There is a large '18' embossed on the lower right. The bottom edge shows a glowing RGB strip and cooling vents. A red headset rests on the lid.
All photos have a watermark: 'ARMANIPIPS DIGITAL STORE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows the '18' embossed on the lid and the Alienware logo; photo 1 shows 'ALIENWARE' text below the screen. The model name is consistent with the visual evidence.

The screen size appears consistent with 18 inches based on proportions, but no on-screen display or specification label confirms 480Hz or FHD+. The screen is on in photo 1, but resolution and refresh rate are not visible.

No visible CPU label or system information screen. The seller's text claims a Ryzen 9 7845HX, but this cannot be verified from photos. The {13th Gen} is likely a mistake, as Ryzen 7000 series is 4th Gen AMD, not 13th Gen Intel.
No system information screen or BIOS visible. RAM and SSD specs cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
No GPU information visible. The '8GB' likely refers to VRAM, but no NVIDIA branding or model is visible on the laptop or screen.
